title: On a conjecture of $λ$-Aluthge transforms and Hilbert--Schmidt self-commutators
summary: Let $A$ be a complex square matrix, and write its polar decomposition as $A=U|A|$. For $0<λ<1$, the $λ$-Aluthge transform of $A$ is defined by $$ Δ_λ(A)=|A|^λU|A|^{1-λ}. $$ In 2007, Huang and Tam conjectured that the Frobenius norm of the self-commutator is contractive under $Δ_λ$: for every $0<λ<1$, $$ \|A^*A-AA^*\|_{F} \ \ge\ \|Δ_λ(A)^*Δ_λ(A)-Δ_λ(A)Δ_λ(A)^*\|_{F}. $$ If this inequality held, then the iterated self-commutator norms $$ \Bigl\{\bigl\|Δ_λ^{\,m}(A)^*Δ_λ^{\,m}(A) -Δ_λ^{\,m}(A)Δ_λ^{\,m}(A)^*\bigr\|_F\Bigr\}_{m\in\mathbb N} $$ would form a nonincreasing sequence and necessarily…
